title: Works as it says
body:
Nice check mark calendar with dark mode and day of the week adjustment. First week use was great… however. 

It says “buy premium to use all features.” Which, I assumed, meant I would still be able to use the app’s basic feature; the checkmark. But that doesn’t work. The whole app is basically useless without premium. 

While I appreciate the one time purchase option to use it, I don’t need a premium. I just need the most basic feature of being able to check mark a date.
author: RaeRosefield
